title: JANUS Genesis Face Microcontrol SOURCE → WORLD → RECEIPT — Runtime Execution Receipt
verified_behaviors: UNDETERMINED is preserved instead of guessed
100 equivalent face proposals retain one external effect budget
one receipt settles all proposals sharing the effect key
Sybil/face multiplicity creates no authority weight
conflicting actions on one effect key enter HOLD until explicit host resolution
SOURCE or WORLD failure blocks authorization
calibration changes routing priority but authority_weight remains zero
a legitimately new external effect requires a new effect key
one valid counterexample challenges a frozen hypothesis regardless of face majority
hypothesis revision uses parent lineage instead of silent rule rewrite

runtime_safety_boundary.meaning: The module is a tested additive authorization/audit guard. It does not itself send payments, mail, tool calls, actuator commands, or other external effects.
